description: This file is a shell script intended for performance testing of Git tag-following behavior with many tags. It sets up repositories, creates complex histories and tags, and measures fetch performance under specific conditions.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Creates a specified number of commits with unique files and a given blob for each commit using Perl and git fast-import.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates tags for each revision in the provided rev-list range.
